dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing of the visible body mass toward the posterior section.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Left lateral margin is smooth and linear; right lateral margin is obscured by water surface turbulence and bubble noise.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate dark-grey skin tone with low specular variance.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct vertical linear mark on the central dorsal axis and faint, sub-parallel diagonal striations on the left lateral surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single, well-defined transverse fold or crease is visible across the posterior portion of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, vertical midline scar and faint diagonal scratches on the left flank.
